{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to only completed orders (exclude refunded)
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate only on completed orders
conversion_by_segment = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Check the result
print("Conversion rate by segment (on completed orders only):\n", conversion_by_segment)

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_by_segment.idxmax()
print(f"Highest conversion rate segment: {best_segment}")"}
